lead_raw_text:
The structure of Tm4Cu2Ag6 (reduced formula Tm2CuAg3) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: Ag and Cu each have 12 geometric neighbors (2 Ag/10 Tm for Ag, 2 Ag/2 Cu/8 Tm for Cu), while Tm has 12 neighbors (4 Ag/4 Cu/4 Tm), with distances spanning roughly 3.06–3.23 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component containing all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts show Ag–Ag and Tm–Tm 12-vertex polyhedra exhibiting corner, edge, and face sharing, while Ag–Cu and Ag–Tm pairs show corner and edge sharing.
